adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/worker-6 re-review reconciled Table 1/2 activity values, Figure 1 peptide identity evidence, supplementary mass/yield context, and linked database conflicts. Remaining database disagreements are explicit cautions, not open rework blockers.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Some linked database rows conflate cyclic/linear/starred variants or carry database-only broad activity labels; these are kept as source_conflict records.
The DOCX supplement supplies mass/yield/HPLC context but no additional MIC/toxicity tables beyond the main XML/PDF tables.
Liposome leakage and CD/NMR support membrane/structure context; no direct biofilm/quorum mechanism is claimed for the engineered peptides.

materials_exhausted.note: All locally obtainable materials relevant to worker-4/worker-6 blockers were opened: XML/PDF, OA package images, DOCX supplement, Figure 1 OCR, and linked database snapshots.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Rows matching Table 1/2 and Figure 1 are source-reviewed; APD6/DRAMP/CAMP/dbAMP rows with monomer-context, cyclic/linear, or duplicate-sequence ambiguity are preserved as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence now records all Table 1 MIC cells and Table 2 MIC/EC50/HC50/IC50/ratio values with μM or ratio units and source locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is limited to membrane permeabilization, structural context, and serum-stability support; background biofilm/immunomodulatory claims are not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material remains complete-with-gaps structurally because supplementary extraction has no spreadsheet tables, but the local DOCX supplement and OA package were opened and are sufficient for the worker-4/6 blocker.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking owner-layer rework remains after bounded source review; cautions are explicit and source-located.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Packet/final files are structurally present; validator success is treated as a prerequisite only, not as publication-grade proof.
